mentions.name: Internal operations tracking tool
mentions.description: This internal tool, assembled quickly for the commenter's company's operations, works well enough for its tracking needs but is not a full CRM, bridging basic inventory tracking and rental asset tracking.
mentions.problem: The space between a full-blown ERP and a spreadsheet tracker is abysmal, with middle managers handling procurement, account management, AR/AP, sales, fleet and field crew while swapping between a dozen different trackers per hour.
mentions.audience: Internal use at the commenter's company.
mentions.source_excerpt: I have something vibed together as an internal tool that does well enough, but definitely not something I would ever refer to as a CRM by any stretch of the imagination and the bridge between basic on-the-shelf inventory and tracking rental assets are two completely different beasts.

evidence.value: I have something vibed together as an internal tool that does well enough, but definitely not something I would ever refer to as a CRM by any stretch of the imagination and the bridge between basic on-the-shelf inventory and tracking rental assets are two completely different beasts.
